summary.text: Machaela Cavanaugh is a member of the Nebraska Unicameral Legislature representing District 6, and was elected in 2018 and re-elected in 2022, according to the Legislature's biography.

paragraphs.text: Machaela Cavanaugh was born on January 17, 1979, in Washington, D.C.

Machaela Cavanaugh graduated from Marian High School, earned a B.A. in sociology from the University of St. Thomas in 2001, and earned a master's degree in public administration from the University of Nebraska-Omaha in 2008.
Machaela Cavanaugh serves on the board of Inclusive Communities.
Machaela Cavanaugh is married to Nicholas A. Brotzel, and they have three children.
